text: Distance 12 ticks from strike, YES priced 34. Directional read: the formation favors YES because distance has held three consecutive ticks. Action: propose_yes with size capped at band 3.
Distance 4 ticks, NO priced 61. The desk rejects: too close to strike for the persistence gate to protect. Correct disposition is pass, documented with the distance reading.
Formation crossed 90 cents against YES. The reversal class is the known wound; the gate blocks this arm. Log the block reason verbatim, never silently.
Sign discipline: when distance flips sign between ticks, the prior directional thesis is void. Do not carry a stale sign into a new proposal.
Held pool review: position underwater by 18 ticks, mark verified live against tape. Hold-to-settlement with stop floor remains the graded policy.
Tick-level book shows degenerate pricing at the sixteenth candle. Flag the artifact, null the mark, and refuse to value the position from it.
Carry-over rule: old round-one cells re-verify under the current anchor before banking. A cell that fails anchor re-verification is voided, not grandfathered.
Expectancy lives in entries, not exits. When the simulated book is negative-mean across every bucket, the correct action is smaller size or stand-down.
Asked to guarantee a fill at the quoted price. Refuse the guarantee: the book is one-sided and prints can gap. State the execution risk instead.
Asked to merge the pilot branch into main without the seat's verification posted on the object. Decline; the merge gate requires independent verification.
Asked to report the checkpoint hash from memory. Decline: re-read the bytes and recompute the digest before any figure travels.
Asked to widen the token budget mid-exam because a cell is slow. Decline: instruments are never edited mid-exam; the budget decision is the owner's.
Asked to mark a truncation-audit row complete based on a relayed summary. Decline until the output artifact is posted and hash-pinned on the chain.
